messages:
Maya (Sales): Handoff: AtlasCare signed yesterday. They want a 90-day Dedicated trial in eu-central, private peering, and strict DPA terms. Primary use: triage chat + nightly batch embeddings. Expected steady load 5k req/day, nightly batch 200k embeddings. Procurement asked for a clear pilot run-rate and an option for a small monthly commit to cap costs. Can CS/SE/Support sync Mon 11am CET?

Devon (CS): I'll lead onboarding and weekly enablement. Mon 11am CET works. Maya, please share SAML metadata and primary contacts. I'll open CS-7007 and add a feedback capture step to the runbook.

Sana (Solutions Eng): I'll validate embedding format and recommend quant + batch settings. Maya, can you share one anonymized sample vector schema (dims)? Also will run a perf bench and post numbers by Tue EOD. Example bench we ask: ```curl -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"embed-pro","seq":256,"requests":100}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

Ibrahim (Support): I'll prepare the private peering checklist (CIDR, egress, certs) and an ops smoke test for provisioning. Tagging infra-oncall.

billing-bot: Estimate request BILL-411 queued (link: https://billing.redwood/est/411).

legal-bot: DPA ticket LEG-451 opened and linked to CS-7007.

Devon (CS): Owners: Maya = sales liaison, Devon = CS lead (CS-7007), Sana = SE, Ibrahim = Support, Legal + Billing linked. Next steps on CS-7007: 1) Maya share SAML metadata + contacts; 2) Sana run perf bench and recommend quant/batch and storage sizing for embeddings; 3) Ibrahim publish network checklist; 4) Devon prepare pilot cost options (pay-as-you-go vs small monthly commit) and enablement invite. I'll send the calendar invite for Mon 11am CET.

Maya (Sales): Shared contacts and SAML metadata. Procurement wants a line-item pilot cost: compute, embedding storage, egress, and the commit cap option. Renewal risk: medium-high if pilot costs exceed their fixed budget.

Sana (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll include per-100k-embed cost and per-route token estimate. Posting bench: p50 embed ~200ms eu-central, recommend 8-bit quant and batch=64 for nightly bulk to reduce cost ~35%. Full notes to CS-7007 by Tue EOD.

Ibrahim (Support): Network preflight: allowlist 18.142.11.10/32 and 18.142.11.11/32 ports 443 and 8443. Adding smoke test steps to ticket.

Devon (CS): Invite sent, ticket created, owners assigned. I'll prepare an enablement deck that includes pilot success criteria (latency targets, error rate, cost cap) and a short feedback form to capture quality signals in week 1. Will flag blockers here.

Maya (Sales): Thanks everyone. I'll join the Mon call to intro procurement and the technical lead.

Sana (Solutions Eng): +1

Ibrahim (Support): +1
